name_reason: Fully compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=animation, descriptor describes summon-spell variant-C 5-slot radial animation, byte-width offsets table. No Ghidra address residue (no _5250c suffix; _5slot is a real dimension proven by the 5-element copy and CMP EBX,0x5 loops, _c is the summon-animation variant letter A/B/C/D, 'byte' reflects the uint8 datatype vs the int32 sibling 'offsets' @ 0x524F8). Name reflects datatype (byte array of offsets). Optional polish '_byte_y_offsets' considered but not required; current name is correct.
purpose: const uint8[5] per-slot byte y-offset table for the summon-spell variant-C 5-slot radial animation; byte-width companion to the int32 x-offset sibling at 0x524F8.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial (@0x26E39) copies all 5 bytes into a local stack buffer (00026E68 MOV ESI,0x5250C; MOVSD; MOVSB -> 4+1=5 bytes; trailing MOVSB not a 2nd MOVSD proves exactly 5 bytes, byte-granular). In the state-4/5 per-slot blit path each element is read unsigned with *1 stride (0002716D MOVZX EDX,byte ptr [ESP+ESI*1+0x2C], ESI=angle_accumulator/scratch sprite-id index) and added as a y-offset before the row_stride multiply (00027172 ADD EDX,[EBX*4+0x54068] then IMUL EDX,EBP). For the enemy team (bTeam==0) the first three local copies are zeroed in place (00026EA9 MOV byte ptr [ESP+EBX*1+0x24],0x0). MOVZX + *1 stride proves element type uint8.
element_semantics: Per-sprite-frame y pixel offset indexed by the animation scratch sprite-id (angle_accumulator, derived from the per-slot frame counter). Values {10, 8, 3, 0, 0} (same logical values as the int32 x-offset sibling, stored byte-wide). Read unsigned; zeroed for enemy team on the first three frames.
notes: Both name and comment kept: existing src comment block (anitab.c lines 356-378) is already accurate, precise, ASCII, evidence-backed, and free of process/phase narrative; editing it would violate the keep-if-already-good rule. anitab.c NOT modified. Ghidra data plate was <null> (empty) so a concise plate reflecting the src conclusion was created via PLATE_COMMENT. const confirmed: only READ + base DATA xrefs (both the MOVSD/MOVSB copy source), zero game-side writers.
